raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: pybind11_json
  version: "0.3.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/pybind/${{ name }}/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b439c7a87d41529daca7d1b87111d434e614d31e07691ba0b3a9173b755830a7

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - if: win
      then: ninja
      else: make
  host:
    - python
    - libpython
    - pybind11 >=3.1,<4.0
    - nlohmann_json >=3.2.0,<4.0
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - package_contents:
      include:
        - pybind11_json/pybind11_json.hpp
      files:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - share/cmake/pybind11_json/pybind11_jsonConfig.cmake
            - share/cmake/pybind11_json/pybind11_jsonConfigVersion.cmake
          else:
            - Library/share/cmake/pybind11_json/pybind11_jsonConfig.cmake
            - Library/share/cmake/pybind11_json/pybind11_jsonConfigVersion.cmake

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11_json
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Using nlohmann::json with pybind11
  description: |
    pybind11_json is an nlohmann::json to pybind11 bridge, it allows you to
    automatically convert nlohmann::json to py::object and the other way around.
  repository: https://github.com/pybind/pybind11_json

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - SylvainCorlay
    - JohanMabille
    - martinRenou
    - wjakob
